key.name: backend
key.description: Server type of the current session. "none" means logged out.

key.name: username
key.description: The account name used to authenticate with the server

key.name: url
key.description: Base URL of the music server, including the scheme

key.name: user-id
key.description: Server-side user ID (Jellyfin). Empty for OpenSubsonic.

key.name: device-id
key.description: Stable client device ID sent to Jellyfin. Generated on first use and kept across logouts.

key.name: last-sync
key.description: Timestamp of the last time that metadata was queried from the server
